intro: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII fears that the Stonewrought Dam is the next target of Dark Iron dwarf aggression following attacks in the Wetlands. With most of the dam's defensive garrison reassigned elsewhere, adventurers are sent to investigate Dark Iron sappers lurking around the eastern ramp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam. First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr! I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat. Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.
That's why I need you, friend. I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam. Investigate the area and bring back a clue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.
